articles.title: Typhoon Dujuan Forces Nearly 2 Million People to Leave Home in Japan
articles.summary: Typhoon Dujuan hit Japan with winds of 130 km/h, forcing almost two million people to evacuate. Power went out for 50,000 homes, flights were cancelled, and even the Tokyo Game Show shut down.

articles.title: World Leaders Meet at the UN to Talk About War, AI, and a Warming Planet
articles.summary: About 130 world leaders are meeting at the United Nations this week to tackle wars, climate change, and the rise of AI. President Trump and France's Macron speak Tuesday, but some big names are skipping.

articles.title: CNN, Politico, and MS NOW Sue Trump After White House Ban
articles.summary: Three news outlets sued the Trump administration after being barred from the White House. Trump accused them of writing "fiction or lies." Major TV networks pulled out of White House coverage in response.
